title: Dead-letter record, v1
description:
Written to `transaction.processing.dlq.v1` when processing an event fails terminally: either the failure was classified non-retryable, or the bounded retry budget was exhausted.

Carries enough to diagnose and to reprocess, and NOTHING sensitive. A DLQ is long-lived storage that operations staff read, which makes it the worst place to put a stack trace, a secret, or an unsanitised payload fragment.

originalEvent.description: The complete original envelope, unmodified, so reprocessing replays exactly what failed rather than a reconstruction of it.

consumer.description: Which consumer group failed. Two consumers of the same topic fail independently.

failureClass.description: Why this is here. RETRY_EXHAUSTED means the failure was transient but did not clear; the others were never worth retrying.

exceptionType.description: Fully-qualified exception class name. The TYPE only - never a stack trace.

sanitisedMessage.description: Exception message with identifiers, credentials and payload fragments removed. Sanitisation is the producer's responsibility and is tested.

attemptCount.description: How many times processing was attempted before this record was written.
